title: Describe an article preview and patch
prompt: The supplied `Article` has `id`, `title` and `published`. Define `Preview` with only `id` and `title`. Define `Patch` with optional `title` and `published`, and no `id`, so a patch cannot change it. Only the types are checked.
hints: Start with `Preview`: which two fields does it keep?
A patch can leave out every field, so `{}` must be a valid `Patch`.
Remove `id` with `Omit`, then make the rest optional with `Partial`.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses the full `Article` for `Preview`, so it requires `published`.
Uses `Partial<Article>`, so a patch can change `id`.

feedback: Start with `Preview`: which two fields does it keep?
